text:
Mia: :rotating_light: noticing a sudden spike in 5xx and request latencies on prod-south-1 since ~08:12 UTC. looks related to KV cache evictions + paging.
IncidentBot: Incident created: KV_CACHE_EVICTION_STORM (sev=high) — paging and continuous-batching errors detected. Pager duty routed to oncall: @raj.
Raj: grabbing it. already seeing continuous batching queues piling up and per-token latency jumping. graphs: cache hit-rate dropped from 98% -> 62% in 3m.
Mia: timeline — we rolled a config change at 08:10 to bump `continuous_batch.max_batch_tokens` from 8192 -> 16384 and `max_num_seqs` from 16 -> 64 on dedicated pools.
Raj: that matches. larger max_batch_tokens + lots of concurrent sequences is causing batch packing to hold requests longer, KV cache footprint exploded -> eviction thrash -> paging IO spikes.
Sylvia: tagging storage team, paging IO looks correlated with evictions. possible cache amplification when many batches request long prefixes.
OpsBot: automated mitigation suggestions: revert `max_batch_tokens`, set `max_num_seqs` back to prior, and increase `kvcache.eviction_threshold` temporarily. Recommend emergency config patch.
Raj: I'm going to roll a canary revert on hostpool-4 first.
Alex: If you revert, also lower `continuous_batch.timeout_ms` from 1200 -> 600 to reduce head-of-line waits. that helped on a past incident.
Raj: applying hotfix (canary) now:```\nkubectl -n redwood set configmap contbatch-config --from-literal=max_batch_tokens=8192 --from-literal=max_num_seqs=16
kubectl rollout restart deployment/contbatch-runtime -n redwood
```
Leo: FYI customer-facing metrics show elevated error rate for customers: AcmeCorp (20% errors), NovaPay (12%), internal test traffic 5xx ~3.8% overall.
Mia: contacting Customer Success to prep messages for AcmeCorp and NovaPay — low-latency API endpoints impacted, recommend failover to dedicated region if needed.
Raj: canary looks good after 90s, latencies back down and cache hit-rate recovering to 94%. continuing rollouts across pools.
IncidentBot: Canary passed. Rolling update to remaining pools with 30s stagger.
Sylvia: storage I/O rates dropping, eviction rate normalized. good to monitor for 10m.
Alex: after rollout, set `continuous_batch.max_batch_tokens` to 12k in a controlled experiment with stricter `timeout_ms=700` and observe for 24h before promoting. we need smaller steps.
Mia: customer impact summary (preliminary): two large customers experienced elevated errors and increased 95p latency by ~350ms for ~12 minutes during the config window. no data loss, requests retried.
Raj: mitigation checklist done: revert, lower timeout, staged rollout, storage throttling lifted. will keep thread live for handoff.
Mia: handoff to sylvia for post-incident analysis and postmortem writeup. Syl, please capture RCA, timeline, and follow-ups (config gating, rollout validation, automatic prechecks).
Sylvia: taking over. initial RCA hypothesis: unchecked jump in batching caps increased KV working set beyond provisioned capacity causing eviction-led paging. follow-ups: add pre-deploy simulation, introduce automated sign-off if `max_num_seqs` * `max_batch_tokens` > threshold, and add a guardrail in console to warn.
OpsBot: scheduled follow-up meeting tomorrow 15:00 UTC for retro and mitigation roadmap.
Mia: closing immediate incident actions. keeping channel open for updates and the postmortem draft. :white_check_mark:
